data.description:
## Problem
The Verified gate's integration tier runs `pytest -n 4 --dist loadgroup --timeout-method=thread`. When a thread-method timeout (or any crash) kills an xdist worker, loadgroup/loadscope requeues the dead node's whole pending workload INCLUDING the crashing item (loadscope.py:166-205), so every respawned worker re-runs it and dies again, up to xdist's default restart cap of numprocesses*4 = 16 (dsession.py:555-568). Measured locally: one 20s-timeout test cost 183s at -n 2 (9 failures from one bad test); at CI integration scale this burns toward the 60-minute job ceiling (bug 3fa7, runs 32585303586 / 32587991195). Upstream xdist #1094/#1189 document the cascade; fixes unmerged as of Aug 2026.

## Approach (operator-approved 2026-08-22, conditional on OSS adoption — condition verified)
Add `--max-worker-restart=0` to the integration (loadgroup) pytest lane in .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml, so a worker crash aborts the session immediately and cleanly (xdist triggershutdown) instead of cascading respawns. Fail-fast precedent: huggingface/transformers sets max-worker-restart=0 globally with group-scoped dist modes (.circleci/create_circleci_config.py); BerriAI/litellm pairs a restart cap with timeout_method=thread; upstream docs/crash.rst sanctions =0 to disable restarting. This is a guard, not the primary fix — the budget restore (change 2115, merged) is the fix; this bounds the blast radius if any test ever hangs again.

Scope: the loadgroup lane only (worksteal does not re-dispatch the crash item — verified empirically). Extend the existing CI-parity contract test (tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py hang-guard family) to pin the flag so it cannot silently regress. No behavior change for green runs.

Note: per the workflow-text provenance rule (Gerrit gate executes _build-and-test.yml from trusted main), this change is inert on its own Verified run and takes effect only after merge. That is expected and fine — its own run just needs to be green.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Integration lane in .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml carries --max-worker-restart=0
- [ ] A contract test pins the flag on the loadgroup lane (RED before the workflow edit, GREEN after)
- [ ] make lint, typecheck, and complexity ratchet clean (new=0 increased=0)
- [ ] No other lane or pytest config altered
data.title: Bound loadgroup worker respawns with --max-worker-restart=0
